text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-Tokyo identified five of Lebanon's detainees as Red Army guerrillas.
-An unidentified car driver fired at a bus carrying Japanese tourists in Baalbek after a right-of-way dispute with the bus driver, police said. No was was hurt.
-Lebanese University teachers went on strike over long-standing demands.
-The five-nation committee monitoring the ceasefire in Lebanon urged Israeli forces and Hizbollah guerrillas to avoid civilian areas in their war.
-French Foreign Minister De Charette: We are working hard to reactivate negotiations on the Syrian and Lebanese tracks.
-Prosecutor General Addoum said Japanese detainees would be prosecuted under Lebanese laws.
-Economy Minister Jaber, at the end of the shopping festival: February was just the beginning.
